integrity: Reproducible exact signed chain matrices, a unimodular 88-by-88 cellular minor, and integer Smith normal forms are embedded. No independence, formal certification, or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation for the one-skeleton of the four-dimensional cube only; not an all-dimensional graph-braid theorem. Possible unindexed equivalent account remains. The result has not undergone independent external audit.
title: A sixfold parity obstruction among coordinate-torus classes of the four-cube two-particle space
